hook.say: EA just announced BioWare is closing.

stories.head: EA: BioWare is closing and early development on the next Mass Effect is ending
stories.say: After more than three decades, EA confirmed BioWare is closing, and early development on the next Mass Effect project is ending. That's the studio behind Baldur's Gate, Knights of the Old Republic, Dragon Age and Mass Effect.
